title: Kinetic Architectural Editorial Layouts
discipline: Architectural Front-End Paradigms · Tectonic Spatial Typography · Modulor Systems · Tactile Editorial Web
hypothesis: Can front-end digital editorial design transcend the frictionless 12-column scroll by structuring responsive web layouts as dynamic architectural folding planes, tactile paper materiality, and non-linear spatial depth, pioneering a completely new aesthetic paradigm for web typography?
